mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 3-month Treasury yield (measured by GDPC1) over the next 60 trading days signals a flattening yield curve that lowers discount rates on future cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 60-day rolling mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.
